targets.query: SELECT max("value") FROM "vus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "test_type" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(sum("value"), 1s) FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "route", "scenario" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(sum("value"), 1s) FROM "iterations" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(null)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(sum("value"), 1s) FROM "dropped_iterations" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(null)

panels.title: Latency p50 / p90 / p95 / p99 / max

targets.query: SELECT median("value") AS "p50", percentile("value", 90) AS "p90", percentile("value", 95) AS "p95", percentile("value", 99) AS "p99", max("value") AS "max" FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE "phase"='measurement' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "route", "scenario", "cache_state" fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") * 100 FROM "http_req_failed" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(null)
SELECT (1 - mean("value")) * 100 FROM "business_correctness" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(null)

SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("value")) FROM /business_check_failures|valuation_invalid_results|cache_isolation_failures|monte_carlo_timeout_count/ WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(0)
SELECT cumulative_sum(sum("value")) FROM "provider_fallback_count" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "scenario" fill(0)
SELECT mean("usage_percent") FROM "docker_container_cpu" WHERE "container_name"='valuator-perf-backend' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage") AS "used", mean("usage_percent") AS "percent" FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "container_name"='valuator-perf-backend' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("rx_bytes"), 1s) AS "rx", non_negative_derivative(mean("tx_bytes"), 1s) AS "tx" FROM "docker_container_net" WHERE "container_name"='valuator-perf-backend' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("uptime_ns") FROM "docker_container_status" WHERE "container_name"='valuator-perf-backend' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT max("numbackends") FROM "postgresql" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "db" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean("xact_commit"), 1s) AS "commit", non_negative_derivative(mean("xact_rollback"), 1s) AS "rollback", non_negative_derivative(mean("deadlocks"), 1s) AS "deadlocks" FROM "postgresql" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "db" fill(null)
